evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/httpserver.cpp to change HTTP server endpoint binding and RPC authentication startup behavior.
rationale: Prevents a local credential leak where bitcoind falls back to IPv6-only listener while bitcoin-cli transmits cookie credentials over IPv4 to an arbitrary local process. Reviewers verified this closes a real credential disclosure vulnerability that allows an attacker squatting on the IPv4 port to capture credentials and control bitcoind over IPv6.
